notes: Annotation depth: CORE — 12 core services + plan-level + appeals_contact. Other Covered Services (abortion, bariatric, routine_eye_exam_adult, acupuncture) and excluded services (chiropractic) and the long tail of services (mental_health_*, substance_abuse_*, prenatal_visit, delivery_*, home_health, pt_rehab, habilitation, skilled_nursing, durable_medical_equipment, hospice_inpatient, childrens_eye_exam, childrens_glasses, childrens_dental, diagnostic_test, outpatient_surgery_*, emergency_transport_ground) are NOT annotated in this fixture. See ambetter-ca-2024-bronze-60-hdhp for the full-depth template covering identical SBC layout.

CSR-enhanced silver signature: $0 in-network deductible. CSR 87 means 87% actuarial value (cost-sharing reduction for households at 100-150% FPL). The cost-share is dramatically richer than standard Silver 70 (20% coinsurance vs 35-40%; $0 deductible vs $5,000+; $3,000 OOP cap vs $9,200). Phase 5 cross-tier match validation should NOT merge silver_87 with silver_70 despite both being 'silver'.
Insurer mapping: same as Bronze 60 HDHP fixture — 'Health Net of CA' legal entity, 'Ambetter' brand, parser maps to 'Centene'.
Coverage period uses single-date format ('Beginning on or after 01/01/2024'); coverage tier is 'All Covered Members'. Both rely on the parser fixes shipped in this PR.
MVS = 'Not Applicable' (individual marketplace plan); annotated as null.

services.coverage_conditions: Supply/order: up to 30 day (retail); 31-90 day (mail), except where quantity limits apply. Prior authorization is required for select drugs or you will be subject to a penalty of 50% of the average wholesale price, except for emergency care.
services.notes: Mail order is $10 (2x retail) — typical for plans that absorb dispensing-fee differential. PA penalty is 50% of AWP, not flat dollar.
services.source_excerpt: Generic drugs (Tier 1) — $5 copay/retail order, $10 copay/mail order. Out-of-network: Not covered.
Preferred brand drugs (Tier 2) — $25 copay/retail order, $50 copay/mail order. Out-of-network: Not covered.
Non-preferred brand drugs (Tier 3) — $45 copay/retail order, $90 copay/mail order. Out-of-network: Not covered.

services.coverage_conditions: Supply/order: 30 day supply from specialty Rx except where quantity limits apply. Prior authorization is required for select drugs or you will be subject to a penalty of 50% of the average wholesale price, except for emergency care.
services.notes: 15% coinsurance with $150 cap per prescription. CSR-87 specialty Rx is dramatically cheaper than standard silver — expect $250-500 cap on Silver 70.
services.source_excerpt: Specialty drugs (Tier 4) — 15% coinsurance up to $150 per prescription. Out-of-network: Not covered.
